description: A buyer orders a meal; the merchant makes it and a courier carries it to the door. Both work directly with the buyer, so neither loses a slice to a delivery platform. Each hand-off is receipted, and both are bonded for more than they are owed — so a single payment settles the kitchen and the ride together.
name: Local commerce
summary: A meal to the door: the merchant and the courier deal direct, and keep the platform's cut.
